old_entry.expected_answer: Birdsong one wood per sawmill in its clearing, finite eight wood supply. Evening one card plus uncovered draw bonuses, discard to five.

new_entry.expected_answer: During Birdsong, place one wood per sawmill in that sawmill's clearing. During Daylight, an optional Overwork action spends a card matching a clearing with a sawmill to place one wood token in that clearing. Production is limited by the finite eight-wood supply; place the maximum available when unable to place all required pieces, and costs are not waived. In Evening, draw one card plus uncovered draw bonuses, then discard chosen hand cards down to five.

corrections.reason: Unqualified when/how much wood production includes both Birdsong sawmill placement and optional Daylight Overwork. No phase limitation appears in the question.

note: Tightens incomplete expected answer based on authoritative source. Historical benchmark files and scores are retained under their original keys; no silent target revision.
